description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential full-time role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on patient care and facility success. The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader committed to upholding the highest standards of quality and compliance.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring exceptional resident care, operational efficiency, and financial performance. You will foster a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff, driving continuous improvement initiatives and maintaining regulatory adherence.This is a critical leadership position within a dynamic healthcare environment, offering a competitive salary and the chance to shape the future of a respected facility. We are looking for a proactive and compassionate leader ready to embrace this challenging yet rewarding opportunity.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven leadership experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations for long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage facility operations and financial performance
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and team-building skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, based on experience.
